text: The Patriots' week has been defined by disappointment and roster tinkering in the wake of Thursday night's 30-24 loss to the Bears, a defeat that saw Caleb Williams throw two touchdown passes while Drake Maye and company couldn't quite keep pace—and one that underscored a troubling reality: Mike Vrabel's team is struggling mightily with turnover differential, one of his four stated pillars of team identity. On the transaction front, the organization re-signed linebacker Jose Ramirez to the practice squad while cutting offensive lineman Jacob Rizy from the same squad and releasing punter Bryce Baringer from injured reserve, suggesting some shuffling in hopes of stabilizing both special teams and depth. The good news? There's little time to dwell on Chicago, as the Patriots face a quick turnaround for Sunday's Week 8 matchup against the Dolphins in Miami at 4:15 PM ET—a game that will be broadcast across multiple platforms for those looking to catch what amounts to a crucial AFC East contest. Meanwhile, running back Rhamondre Stevenson continues to be a bright spot, operating on the cusp of his sixth straight 100-carry season while handling the little things that often go unnoticed.
